Sezzle's pay-in-4 plan splits your purchase into four equal installments over six weeks. The first installment is charged at the time of purchase, and the remaining three installments are charged every two weeks thereafter. Each installment is 25% of the total purchase amount. You can pay any installment early at no additional cost, and early payment does not change the due dates of later installments. If you need to reschedule an upcoming installment, the first reschedule is free and can push the date up to two weeks. Each subsequent reschedule costs $5, and you can reschedule a maximum of three times per order. If you miss a payment, a $10 failed-payment fee will be added, and your account will be deactivated until the balance is settled. For more detailed information, please refer to the specific policies on rescheduling and failed payments.
